_seatWeights: How many regular seats each seat counts as in the usage dashboard's pooled numbers (default 1; 0 leaves a seat out). Per provider (claude, codex, grok, gemini), by seat letter. Wins over planWeights.
_planWeights: Same, by the plan the provider reports for the seat (Codex only today: shown in the dashboard's Codex table). Providers do not publish exact multipliers, so you state them.
